old_author_claims_withdrawn: Earlier author reports counted web trace identifiers as actual returned source reads, including KR02 R1–R8 and K09 R1–R2. The actual external responses were not retained/observed for those assertions; the claimed access and coverage counts are not reliable and are withdrawn as proof of verified sources. Matching internal JSON and hashes only proves artifact identity, not retrieval.
prior_independent_review: R9 review comment 7218405055 explicitly reported source corroboration for twelve narrow propositions; formal local verdict 7218812300 is recorded with its original scope. This correction neither invents new independent verdict nor changes reviewed bytes. Other older claimed source reads are not rescued by aggregate structural review.
consumption_gate: All author-trace-only evidence_for bindings and historical source-supported claims must be held from empirical/theory-source-dependent use unless actual retrievable evidence or exact independent source corroboration resolves the claim. Original project rules, finite arithmetic and synthetic methods with independent evidence remain usable within reviewed nonempirical scope. G03 must adjudicate this restriction and resolve indispensable source support; do not infer all local claims are externally source-qualified.
